title: Building visibility · Facades only open when they hide Gerard
description: The inaccessible corner beside Fruites Meridiana keeps its facade while Gerard is visible. Walking along it never opens a hole. An actual obstruction in the passage still opens, with neighbouring buildings left whole, and closes again in the open street.

steps.eval: window.buildingCutRadii = () => window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Entorno: meridiana-calle').find(e => !!e.render).flatMap(e => e.render.meshInstances).map(m => m.getParameter('geoCutRadius')?.data).filter(r => r !== undefined); if (window.buildingCutRadii().some(r => r > 0)) throw new Error('The unobstructing corner must stay whole');

steps.caption: Beside the inaccessible corner: both characters are visible and the facade stays whole

steps.eval: if (window.buildingCutRadii().some(r => r > 0)) throw new Error('Walking beside the fruit shop must not open its facade');

steps.caption: Along Fruites Meridiana: being close to a facade does not activate the cut

steps.eval: const radii = window.buildingCutRadii(); if (!radii.some(r => r > 4.9)) throw new Error('An actual obstruction must still open'); if (!radii.some(r => r === 0)) throw new Error('Unobstructing neighbouring buildings must stay whole');

steps.caption: In the passage: only the building that hides Gerard opens; its neighbours keep their facades

steps.eval: if (window.buildingCutRadii().some(r => r > 0)) throw new Error('All cuts must close again in the open street');

steps.caption: Back in the open street: every facade closes again
